titleUk: Фрірен: Похоронний обряд у кінці мандрівки
clues: The narrative begins precisely where a ten-year heroic campaign concludes, measuring time by meteor showers that return once every half-century.
Mundane folk spells—such as turning sweet grapes sour or polishing bronze statues—are prized more highly than battlefield magic.
A protagonist with a near-immortal lifespan retraces an old party's footsteps northward toward where souls are said to rest.
Demons in this world mimic human speech not out of empathy, but as an evolutionary predation strategy.
An elven mage who outlived her hero party takes on a human apprentice named Fern on a journey to Aureole.
